blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Self-supervised speech models encode rich phonetic information, but it remains unclear how to transform this information into interpretable metrics for second-language (L2) pronunciation assessment in spontaneous speech.
We propose a native-reference coordinate geometry in which phone-class averages from native speech define a low-dimensional reference subspace, and L2 speech is evaluated by its distance to matching native phone-class coordinates.
Unlike prior distance-based approaches, our method does not require parallel recordings with matched linguistic content or dedicated pronunciation labels.
Across different self-supervised encoders and modeling choices, the resulting native-reference distances show negative Spearman correlations up to − 0.5 -0.5 with speaking proficiency, indicating that higher-proficiency speakers tend to lie closer to the native-reference space.
blocks.zh:
自我监督的语音模型编码了丰富的语音信息,但仍然不清楚如何将这些信息转化为自发语音中第二语言(L2)发音评估的可解释度量衡.
我们提出本土参考坐标几何法,其中来自本土语音的电话类平均值定义了一个低维参考子空间,L2语音按其距离来评价与本土电话类坐标匹配.
与之前的远程方法不同的是,我们的方法不需要配对语言内容的并行录音或专用的发音标签.
通过不同的自我监督编码器和建模选择,由此产生的本土参考距离显示Spearman与演讲能力之间的负相关性高达0.5-0.5,表明高水平的演讲者往往更接近本土参考空间。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Motivation
blocks.zh: 1 导言和动机

blocks.en:
Second language (L2) speaking proficiency is commonly described using the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) , which defines ordered proficiency levels from A1 to C2 [ 1 ] .
Within the CEFR framework, phonological competence is one component of communicative language ability and is captured by a dedicated phonological control scale.
Automatic speaking assessment systems have been developed to predict holistic L2 speaking proficiency from learner speech, including scores aligned with CEFR proficiency levels [ 2 , 3 ] .
However, a holistic proficiency prediction does not necessarily reveal how pronunciation-related information is represented in the underlying speech model.
The pronunciation assessment based on Goodness-of-Pronunciation (GoP) evaluates pronunciation at the phone level by comparing an observed realization with its expected realization under an acoustic model [ 4 ] .
However, this type of assessment has focused on read-aloud or otherwise constrained speech with known transcriptions [ 5 ] , making its broader application to spontaneous speech less straightforward.
blocks.zh:
第二语言(L2)发言熟练程度通常使用欧洲通用语言参考框架(CEFR)来描述,该框架定义了从A1到C2[1]的有序熟练程度.
在CEFR框架内,配音能力是交流语言能力的一个组成部分,由专用的配音控制尺度捕获.
已开发了自动语音评估系统,以预测学习者语言中整体的L2语音熟练程度,包括与CEFR熟练程度水平一致的分数[2,3].
然而,一个整体的熟练程度预测并不一定能揭示与发音相关的信息在基础语音模型中是如何体现的.
基于Goodness-of-Profinition(GOP)的发音评估通过在声学模型下将观察到的实现与其预期实现相比较来评价电话层面的发音[4].
然而,这种评估侧重于用已知的抄录语读音或其他限制性的语音[5],使其对自发语音的更广泛应用不那么直接。

blocks.en:
In recent years, various studies have investigated the phonetic information captured in self-supervised speech models [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
Further evidence comes from analyses of representations extracted from phone-aligned segments, which show that the self-supervised features encode context-dependent phone information [ 10 , 11 ] .
In particular, these representations are not restricted to information from the corresponding phone, but also incorporate larger context [ 12 ] .
However, these findings do not directly yield an interpretable metric for L2 pronunciation assessment.
blocks.zh:
近年来,各种研究调查了在自我监督的语音模型中获取的语音信息[6,7,8,9].
进一步的证据来自对从电话对接部分中提取的表示的分析,这些显示自我监督的功能编码了依赖上下文的电话信息[10,11].
特别是,这些陈述不仅限于从相应的电话中获取信息,而且还包含更大的上下文[12]。
然而,这些结论并没有直接产生L2读音评估的可解释的衡量标准.

blocks.en:
Prior work has investigated distance measures based on dynamic time warping alignments between L2 and native speech, represented by conventional Mel-cepstral or self-supervised features [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . However, these approaches require parallel recordings of the same text from both speakers and may be sensitive to disfluencies, which are common in L2 speech.
We propose an approach that does not require matched linguistic content.
To avoid the need for utterance-level parallelism we use a phone-class level comparison, where L2 and native speech are compared only through shared classes, after projecting their representations into a common native-derived subspace.
For this purpose, we investigate whether there exists a low-dimensional geometric subspace within self-supervised feature spaces where (1) L2 phone realizations can be anchored to native-reference phone representations and (2) a distance measure can quantify L2 pronunciation deviation.
Using self-supervised representations of utterances of a native corpus we accumulate phone-class averaged representations using segment boundary information via the Viterbi alignment from an external frame-wise model.
We then introduce a low-rank native phone-class coordinate space and its corresponding projection basis by performing singular value decomposition (SVD) .
For each L2 utterance, we project its phone-class averages into the native projection basis, yielding L2 phone-class coordinates.
Pronunciation deviation is measured as the distance between L2 and native-reference coordinates for matching phone-classes, using different distance measures.
Notably, we do not train a model using the representations or the distances to predict the proficiency level.
Instead, we test the raw distance validity of the proposed method.
We propose that if the native-reference subspace captures pronunciation-relevant information, then speakers with higher proficiency level should, on average, have lower native-reference distances.
We evaluate this hypothesis using Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient [ 16 ] .
Moreover, we analyze how the correlation between the distance and proficiency level is affected by the choice of phone-class, averaging method, and subspace rank dimension, as well as the choice of self-supervised model and the encoder layer.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作调查了基于L2与原生语音之间动态时间曲折对调的距离测量,以传统的Mel-cepstral或自我监督的特征为代表[13,14,15]. 然而,这些办法要求两位发言者对同一案文进行平行录音,并可能对L2发言中常见的缺陷敏感。
我们建议采取一种不需要相应语言内容的方法。
为了避免言语层面的平行性,我们使用电话类的比较,即L2和本地语只能通过共享类进行比较,然后将其表达投射到共同的本地衍生子空间.
为此,我们调查在自监控的特征空间中是否存在一个低维几何亚空间,其中(1)L2手机实现可以定位到本土参考电话表示,(2)远程测量可以量化L2发音偏差.
利用自我监督的对原生生物体的表达方式,我们通过从外部框架看的Viterbi调整,利用分界线信息,积累了电话类平均表达方式。
然后,我们通过进行单值分解(SVD),引入低档本地电话类坐标空间及其相应的预测基础。
对于每句L2话,我们将其电话类平均值投射到原生投影基,得出L2电话类坐标.
读音偏差被测量为L2与本地参考坐标之间的距离,用于匹配电话类,使用不同的距离测量.
值得注意的是,我们没有利用表述或距离来训练一种模型来预测熟练程度。
相反,我们检验拟议方法的原始距离有效性。
我们建议,如果本土参考子空间能捕捉到与发音相关的信息,那么熟练程度较高的发言者平均应拥有较低的本土参考距离。
我们用斯皮尔曼的等级关联系数来评价这个假设[16].
此外,我们分析距离与熟练程度之间的关联性如何受到选择电话类,平均方法,和亚空间排名维度,以及选择自我监督模型和编码层的影响.

blocks.en:
We use feature-slicing [ 6 ] over phone-class segment boundaries provided by an alignment.
For the common monophone, diphone and triphone phone-classes, we adopt two different averaging strategies, based on how the segment boundaries are defined.
While center-phone averaging considers feature vectors aligned to the center phone of each unit, full-unit averaging aggregates in addition the frames aligned to all phones in the phone-class unit.
A comparison of the two averaging strategies for a triphone phone-class is depicted in Fig. 1 of Appendix A .
Note that the two strategies coincide for monophones, since center-phone and full-unit pooling both reduce to averaging the frames aligned to the single phone.

虽然中线手机平均考虑与每个单元的中线手机对齐的特征矢量,但除电话类单元中与所有电话对齐的帧外,全单元平均总和.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the association between native-reference distances Δ \Delta and the CEFR -aligned speaking proficiency using Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient ρ \rho [ 16 ] .
We verify whether higher-proficiency L2 speakers tend to have lower native-reference distances by measuring the monotonic association between the distance and CEFR based on their relative ordering.
Lower distances indicate greater similarity to the native-reference coordinates, while higher CEFR scores indicate greater proficiency.
Therefore, a negative Spearman correlation would indicate that native-reference distance decreases as proficiency increases, supporting an inverse association between the distance and the CEFR .
As a rule of thumb for rank correlations with human assessment data, | ρ | ≈ 0.3 |\rho|\approx 0.3 is often treated as a moderate association, while | ρ | ≈ 0.5 |\rho|\approx 0.5 indicates a meaningful monotonic relationship, especially when the method is not directly trained on the target ratings.

距离较低表明与本土参考坐标的相似度更高,而较高的CEFR分数则表明熟练度更高.
因此,负面的Spearman关系将表明本土参考距离随着熟练程度的提高而减少,支持距离和CEFR之间的反向联系。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Models and Setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 模式和设置

blocks.en:
We use TIMIT [ 18 ] as our native speech corpus together with its official phone segment boundaries.
For L2 speech we use train and dev partitions of the Speak and Improve Speak Corpus 2025 (S&I) corpus [ 19 , 3 ] .
For the train data, only utterances with manual transcriptions are used.
While modeling aspects such as averaging strategies and choices of phone-class are evaluated using the train data, all other experiments additionally use the dev data.
Each subset is divided into four different proficiency evaluation tasks.
For reporting the evaluation results, we first calculate Spearman’s coefficient for each part and then average the values, following common practice in the literature.
Here, we report the Fisher average [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们使用TIMIT [18] 作为我们的本地语音 及其官方电话段边界。
对于L2的演讲,我们使用"演说与改进"(Seak and Professional Corpus 2025 (S&I) act [19, 3])的列车和dev分区.
对于列车数据,仅使用手动抄录的语音.
在利用列车数据评估平均策略和选择电话等级等建模方面,所有其他实验都额外使用dev数据。
每个子集分为四个不同的熟练程度评价任务.
为了报告评价结果,我们首先计算斯皮尔曼各部分的系数,然后按照文献中常见的做法平均数值。
在这里,我们报告费舍尔的平均 [20]。

blocks.en:
We extract self-supervised features from different layers of pretrained models belonging to WavLM [ 21 ] and wav2vec2.0 [ 22 ] families.
A summary of the model parameters and the used layers is reported in Table 1 .
We use two neural based frame-wise alignment models.
As the primary model, we used a Conformer based factored hybrid Hidden Markov Model (HMM) [ 23 ] , trained on the small subset of the Loquacious [ 24 , 25 ] ,
and a wav2vec2.0 CTC fine-tuned on TIMIT 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/speech31/wav2vec2-large-english-TIMIT-phoneme_v3 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en:
In Tables 2 , 3 , 4 and 5 , we investigate different modeling and experimental choices and report the averaged Spearman coefficient on the S&I task.
To compare phone-class and averaging choices, we first fix several conditions: since the rank is mathematically bounded above by the number of phone-classes minus one, we set it to 16, which is appropriate for smaller monophone class set.
We also use center-phone averaging and select the middle encoder layer, consistent with our layer-wise experiments, which we do not report here, and prior findings [ 6 ] .
Under these conditions, Table 2 shows that triphone classes perform best, and that the optimal correlation depends on the encoder type.
We then fix the triphone class and compare averaging strategies in Table 3 , observing stronger negative Spearman correlations for the full-unit strategy with WavLM encoders and for the center-phone strategy with wav2vec 2.0.
For rank selection and alignment analysis, we fix the triphone class with full-unit averaging.
As shown in Table 4 , the best rank is 64.
Finally, Table 5 shows that HMM -based alignment leads to stronger negative correlations than CTC -based alignment, likely because the blank label in the CTC topology serves both label repetition and silence, which can lead to less accurate segmentation.
Nevertheless, CTC alignment still yields reasonable correlations.
blocks.zh:
在表2、表3、表4和表5中,我们调查了不同的模型和实验选择,并报告了关于“S&I”任务的平均Spearman系数。
为了比较电话类和平均选择,我们首先确定几个条件:由于排名在数学上以电话类数减1为界,所以设定为16,这适合于较小的单声道类集.
我们也使用中线电话平均并选择中间编码层,与我们分层的实验一致,我们不报告这些实验,以及先前的发现[6].
在这些情况下,表2显示tribhone类表现最好,最佳的关联性取决于编码器类型.
然后我们修补Triphone类, 比较表3中的平均策略,
为了进行军衔选择和校准分析,我们用全单位平均值来固定Triphone级.
如表4所示,最佳军衔为64人。
最后,表5显示,基于HMM的对齐导致比基于CTC的对齐更强的负相关,这可能是因为CTC地形中的空白标签既服务于标签重复,也服务于沉默,这会导致分化不准确.
然而,反恐委员会的配合仍然产生合理的关联。

blocks.en:
There is no directly comparable prior result for our setting, since related studies differ in the assessment target, speech setting, or supervision used.
For context, listener-rated accentedness and comprehensibility correlate modestly with overall oral proficiency ( ρ = − 0.260 \rho=-0.260 and − 0.345 -0.345 , respectively) [ 28 ] .
Conversely, supervised systems on the same S&I proficiency task reach Spearman correlations around 0.83 0.83 [ 3 ] , but are trained on proficiency labels and can exploit information beyond pronunciation. Against these contextual rather than direct comparisons, our ρ ≈ − 0.5 \rho\approx-0.5 with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval of [ − 0.5294 , − 0.4591 ] [-0.5294,-0.4591] indicates a clear negative association: higher-proficiency speakers tend to be closer to the native-reference space, without training a supervised proficiency predictor.

我们的设定没有可直接比较的事先结果,因为相关研究在使用的评估目标、言论设定或监督方面各不相同。
就上下文而言,听众评分的重音和理解度与总体口语熟练程度(分别= - 0.260\rho=-0.260和0.345-0.345)略有关联[28]。
反之,在相同的S&I能力任务上受监督的系统达到斯皮尔曼的关联度约为0.830.83[3],但接受过能力标签培训,可以利用发音以外的信息. 对照这些背景而非直接比较,我们的 \ − − 0.5\\\\\ 0.5, 95%的靴子置信间隔是 [ − 0. 5294, − 0.4591] [-0.5294,-0.4591] , 表明明显的负面关联: 高水平的演讲者往往更接近本土参考空间, 没有受过监督的熟练程度预测员。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusions and Future Work
blocks.zh: 4. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We proposed a native-reference coordinate geometry for analyzing L2 pronunciation deviation in self-supervised speech representations.
Unlike previous approaches, our approach does not require matched text between L2 and native speech.
We construct low-rank coordinate matrices from native and L2 phone-class averages of self-supervised features, and show that the resulting distances yield negative Spearman correlations of up to around − 0.5 -0.5 with speaker proficiency level, suggesting that our proposed method captures meaningful proficiency-related information.
Our results further show that the choice of phone-class, averaging strategy, rank, encoder, and alignment affects the strength of this correlation.
Future work will further investigate the methodology, robustness across additional corpora, and the effect of alignment.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个本土参考坐标几何,用于分析L2在自我监督的语音表述中的发音偏差.
与以往的做法不同,我们的做法并不要求在L2和本地语音之间匹配文本。
我们从本地和L2电话级的自控特征平均值中构建了低级坐标矩阵,并显示由此形成的距离可产生0.5-0.5左右的副斯皮尔曼(Spearman)与扬声器熟练程度的负相关关系,这表明我们提议的方法能够捕捉有意义的熟练程度相关信息。
我们的结果进一步表明,选择电话类,平均策略,级别,编码器,以及校正,都影响了这种关联的强度.
今后的工作将进一步调查方法、其他公司之间的稳健性以及调整的影响。
